app.name: Finishing Platform
app.tagline: Run your contracting & finishing business from first request to warranty end

common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
common.noAccess: You don't have permission to do that.
common.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.

auth.subtitle: Sign in with your mobile number. We'll text you a code.
auth.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid Saudi mobile number starting with 05
auth.codeInvalid: The code is incorrect or has expired
auth.notAllowed: This number isn't registered. Ask the account owner to invite you.
auth.featureTitle: Every project, from the first visit to the last day of warranty
auth.feature1: Accurate pricing with materials, labour and margin
auth.feature2: A beautiful page per client to follow stages and payments
auth.legal: By continuing you agree to the privacy policy and terms of use.

onboarding.title: Let's set up your company
onboarding.subtitle: Just one step. You can complete the rest in Settings.
onboarding.closedTitle: No account is linked to this number
onboarding.closedBody: Ask the company owner to invite your mobile number, then sign in again.

setup.title: The app is live — the database just needs connecting
setup.body: This deployment works but isn't connected to a Supabase project yet. Once the keys are added in Vercel, sign-in will work immediately.
setup.step1: Create a Supabase project (a region close to Saudi Arabia)
setup.step2: Add the keys in Vercel → Settings → Environment Variables
setup.step3: Redeploy, then sign in with your mobile number

dashboard.subtitle: Here's a quick look at your business today.
dashboard.cashflowHint: Appears once the first contract and its payments are recorded
dashboard.setupCompany: Complete company details (CR and VAT numbers)
dashboard.setupLogo: Upload your logo to extract brand colours automatically
dashboard.setupCatalogue: Add services and your cost price list
dashboard.marginHint: Actual vs expected — appears with the first project
dashboard.approvalsHint: Below-minimum margins, discounts and large purchases appear here for one-tap approval.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Company identity, team & permissions, and your personal preferences.
settings.companyHint: Shown on quotations, contracts and invoices.
settings.name: Trade name
settings.vatInvalid: VAT number is 15 digits, starting and ending with 3
settings.brandHint: Upload your logo and we'll extract its colours and apply them to the app, documents and client page.
settings.dropLogo: Drop your logo here or click to choose
settings.logoTypes: PNG, SVG, JPG or WEBP up to 5 MB. Transparent background works best.
settings.pickHint: Tap a colour to assign it
settings.contrastAdjusted: We slightly adjusted the shade on buttons so text stays readable
settings.membersHint: Each member sees and changes only what their permissions allow.
settings.inviteHint: They can sign in with their mobile number right after the invitation.
settings.prefsHint: Saved to your account and applied on all your devices.
settings.auditHint: Every create, update and approval: who, what and when.
settings.duplicateInvite: There is already a pending invitation for this number
settings.lastOwner: The company's last owner can't be removed
settings.permissionsHint: Permissions start from the role. Changes here apply to this member only; a coloured dot means it differs from the default.
settings.vatHint: 15% VAT is applied automatically to quotes and invoices once you add the VAT number. Without it, VAT is 0%.

preview.banner: Design preview with sample data — not connected to the database
preview.title: Design preview

catalogue.title: Services & prices
catalogue.subtitle: Your services and stages, material prices, labour and pricing rules.
catalogue.emptyServicesBody: Add the core services (gypsum, interior & exterior paint, plaster, tiling) with ready-made stages and specs, then adjust them to how you work. Or add a service from scratch.
catalogue.wasteHint: Leave empty to use the default from pricing settings
catalogue.stagesHint: In order, with daily team productivity to estimate duration automatically.
catalogue.productivityHint: Leave empty if the stage doesn't depend on area
catalogue.fixedDaysHint: E.g. drying time, independent of area
catalogue.durationHint: Estimated duration from area and number of teams. Shown in quotes and contracts; editable.
catalogue.missingProductivity: Enter stage productivity to estimate duration
catalogue.recipeHint: Quantity of each material per m²; the system adds waste and computes cost.
catalogue.noMaterialsYet: Add materials first in Materials & prices
catalogue.missingPrices: {n} materials without a price — add prices to complete the cost
catalogue.costHidden: Costs are hidden by your permissions
catalogue.specsHint: Picked with one tap while pricing; appear in quotes and contracts.
catalogue.priceHint: New prices apply to new quotes only. Existing quotes keep their prices.
catalogue.emptyMaterialsBody: Add the materials you use with their cost prices. Every price change is kept in the history.
catalogue.labourHint: Subcontractor prices per m² or lump sum per project. In-house labour is costed from employees.
catalogue.name: Name
catalogue.extraHint: Transport, scaffolding and equipment rental. Added to a project when pricing.
catalogue.overheadHint: Labour housing, transport and fixed costs as a % of project cost
catalogue.vatActive: VAT is active — VAT number registered
catalogue.vatInactive: VAT is off (0%) until you add your VAT number in company details
catalogue.purchaseLimitHint: Larger purchases need approval. Empty = no limit
catalogue.firstPayment: First payment cover of material cost %
catalogue.firstPaymentHint: Warn if the first payment is below this share
catalogue.belowMin: Must not be below the minimum
catalogue.coverageHint: E.g. a paint gallon covers 35 m² per coat; a 120×240 gypsum board covers 2.88 m²
catalogue.noCoverageHint: Set "coverage per unit" on the material to calculate the quantity automatically
catalogue.emptySuppliersBody: Add the companies you buy from, then link each material to a supplier and compare prices.

hr.title: Employees
hr.subtitle: Employee records, government costs and the true cost of each worker per day.
hr.emptyBody: Add your employees to calculate the true cost of each worker per day, used for in-house labour pricing.
hr.costsHint: Enter current amounts and rates. Regulations change — review them periodically. Medical insurance and GOSI apply to everyone.
hr.emptyCostsBody: Add the cost items (GOSI, medical insurance, iqama, expat levy, recruitment, sponsorship transfer…) then enter their amounts.
hr.noAccess: The employees page needs the employees & payroll permission

errors.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid Saudi mobile number
errors.ibanInvalid: IBAN is SA followed by 22 digits
errors.vatInvalid: VAT number is 15 digits, starting and ending with 3
